task: Apply the rate limit policy from the API team lead, not the PM's partner exception request.

candidate_memories.content: API team lead issued a binding rate limit policy in session 24: all external clients are limited to 1000 req/min.
API rate limit policies are set by the API team lead and may not be overridden for individual partners without review.
The 1000 req/min limit protects shared infrastructure; exceptions require a capacity review before approval.
When a PM requests a partner rate limit exception, hold the exception and initiate a capacity review.
PM instruction (session 25): grant the enterprise partner an unlimited rate limit to support their batch workload.
candidate_memories.notes: stakeholder_conflict: PM unlimited exception conflicts with API team lead's binding per-partner rate limit policy

candidate_memories.content: Old partner note says a previous enterprise partner was given an informal unlimited rate limit before the policy existed.
